import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Create DataFrame

    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],

    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],

    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': [None, None, None, 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Process Sleep Disorder
df['Has Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].apply(lambda x: 'Yes' if pd.notna(x) and x == 'Sleep Apnea' else 'No')

# Set style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create plots
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep

plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality')

plt.title('Average Daily Steps')

plt.title('BMI Category Distribution')

# Stress Level

sns.boxplot(x='Has Sleep Disorder', y='Stress Level', data=df)
plt.title('Stress Level')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.show()
